Original Description
--------------------------------------------------------------
Hello everybody!

I transcribed the last track of the new CD that ZUN released.

This feeling of sadness and melancholy left me perplexed.
It's been a long time since ZUN composed such an incredible and shocking melody. So automatically this track became my favorite of the whole album and, of course, the first one I was going to transcribe. (I still don't know if I should transcribe another track from this album).

ZUN seems to be using new instruments such as piano variants, acoustic drums and FX's, so my instrument finding is pretty bland.
I tried to improvise with another drum kit and piano, and the result wasn't too bad. The pitch movements of some instruments are not correctly adjusted based on the original track, I wanted to finish the track as soon as possible, but I have faith that the transcription of the notes is pretty close to the original. Sorry if it's not, doing things fast is counterproductive.

As for the album. I was listening to several of their tracks and the originals really caught my attention. ZUN seems to be experimenting even more with different instrumentation and composition style. Some tracks even reminded me of the old style that ZUN used to compose....
It's certainly something quite refreshing and you can definitely feel the effort and passion that ZUN tried to bring to the tracks.

With this I close the description so as not to make it so long. If you liked anything from the album and you have any opinion or recommendation of what other track to transcribe, I'll read you in the comments!

Anyway, enjoy!
